versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md from the skill package.
- No functional or logic changes; the skill remains read-only and diagnostic per previous documentation.

- Improved and clarified the skill's usage boundaries and mandatory operational rules for diagnosing OSS endpoint and internal network access issues.
- Expanded read-only enforcement, prohibiting any generating, writing, or execution of mutating OSS API commands both by agents and for users.
- Mandated strict entry-point usage: all diagnostics must use the provided scripts, never ad-hoc OSS/SKD/ossutil commands.
- Explicitly covered custom-domain (CNAME) endpoint diagnosis as in-scope, with precise instructions for symptom matching and boundaries vs. sibling skills.
- Required all findings to be strictly evidence-based, citing only script-verified data and officially returned documentation URLs—never fabricated information.
- Enhanced reporting guidelines: on any API error, always output a degraded status and clear next steps, ensuring full transparency on limitations.
